pvp.title: PvP
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.`clan_name` AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level AS clan_level, character_subclasses.class_id AS class_id, character_subclasses.`level` AS level, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN character_subclasses ON characters.obj_Id = character_subclasses.char_obj_id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id LEFT JOIN clan_subpledges ON characters.clanid = clan_subpledges.clan_id AND clan_subpledges.type = 0 WHERE character_subclasses.active = 1 ORDER BY pvpkills DESC, time_in_game DESC LIMIT 10

pk.title: PK
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.`clan_name` AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level AS clan_level, character_subclasses.class_id AS class_id, character_subclasses.`level` AS LEVEL, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest  FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN character_subclasses ON characters.obj_Id = character_subclasses.char_obj_id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id LEFT JOIN clan_subpledges ON characters.clanid = clan_subpledges.clan_id  AND clan_subpledges.type = 0  WHERE character_subclasses.active = 1  ORDER BY pkkills DESC, time_in_game DESC  LIMIT 10

online.title: Online
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.online, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.`clan_name` AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, character_subclasses.class_id, character_subclasses.level AS level, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id LEFT JOIN character_subclasses ON characters.obj_Id = character_subclasses.char_obj_id LEFT JOIN clan_subpledges ON characters.clanid = clan_subpledges.clan_id AND clan_subpledges.type = 0 WHERE character_subclasses.isBase = 1 ORDER BY characters.onlinetime DESC LIMIT 10;

exp.title: EXP
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.`clan_name` AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level AS clan_level, character_subclasses.class_id AS class_id, character_subclasses.`level` AS LEVEL, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest  FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN character_subclasses ON characters.obj_Id = character_subclasses.char_obj_id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id LEFT JOIN clan_subpledges ON characters.clanid = clan_subpledges.clan_id  AND clan_subpledges.type = 0 WHERE character_subclasses.active = 1 ORDER BY character_subclasses.exp DESC, time_in_game DESC  LIMIT 10

clan.title: Clans
query: SELECT clan_data.hasCastle AS castle_id, clan_data.reputation_score, clan_data.leader_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, characters.sex, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE clanid = clan_data.clan_id) AS clan_count_members FROM clan_data INNER JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.obj_Id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id WHERE clan_data.clan_level >= 3 ORDER BY clan_data.clan_level DESC, clan_data.reputation_score DESC, clan_count_members DESC LIMIT 10

castle.title: Castle
query: SELECT castle.id AS castle_id, castle.tax_percent AS tax, castle.treasury, castle.siege_date AS siege_date, clan_data.clan_name AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.char_name AS player_name, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest FROM castle LEFT JOIN clan_data ON castle.id = clan_data.hasCastle LEFT JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.obj_Id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id;

account_characters.title: Account Characters
query: SELECT characters.obj_id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, character_subclasses.class_id, character_subclasses.`level`, clan_data.clan_name AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, clan_data.crest AS clan_crest, ally_data.crest AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id LEFT JOIN ally_data ON clan_data.ally_id = ally_data.ally_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT char_obj_id, class_id, `level` FROM character_subclasses WHERE isBase = 1) AS character_subclasses ON characters.obj_Id = character_subclasses.char_obj_id WHERE characters.account_name = ?;

plugin_get_farm_top.title: Farm Top
query: SELECT items.item_id AS item_id, SUM(items.count) AS total_count, (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_owner_id, (SELECT char_name FROM characters WHERE obj_Id = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_name, (SELECT SUM(count) FROM items AS owner_items WHERE owner_items.item_id = items.item_id AND owner_items.owner_id = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_item_count FROM items WHERE items.item_id IN (%s) GROUP BY items.item_id;
